# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 1

This hotfix improves driver management and restores Android shortcuts, with a new way to refresh global settings without reinstalling the app.

## Vulkan drivers

- Fixed downloads from driver catalogs that had stopped working.
- Improved package checks and clearer messages for unsupported or incompatible driver packages.
- Driver compatibility still depends on the device and package; this update does not make every custom driver compatible with every device.

## Android shortcuts

- Fixed game shortcuts not being created from the game menu.
- Fixed copying game launch links from the same menu.
- Android still asks for confirmation before adding a shortcut to the Home screen.

## Reset global settings

- Added a circular-arrow button beside the Settings search bar to restore global cvars to the current code defaults.
- A confirmation explains what will be reset. Afterward, you can immediately rerun initial setup to choose the app and console languages and review console options.
- Per-game overrides, storage locations, library, profiles, saves, drivers and patch selections are preserved.
- No settings are reset automatically when updating. The reset is optional and takes effect the next time a game starts.

## Updating

- Update in place; there is no need to uninstall or delete data.
- Verified on Odin 2. Wider device and driver coverage remains limited.
- TV mode and synchronized player profiles remain highly experimental and may still have issues.
- X360 Companion is unchanged.
